source: November 20 metadata, six AI/plugin queries and six ordinary-topic queries. Eligible videos and uploaders unique in this draw. Choose the two highest metadata reply counts per query (break ties by BV); if exhausted, fill with same pool. Alternate assignment of first/second rank to natural and diagnostic within each pool.
frame: Time-sorted roots and inline replies returned by these pages, within [start,stop). Retain every eligible natural comment ID including repeated text. No score-based replacements. Report sampling scope and exclusions.
isolation: Exclude previously observed BV/aid, UID, normalized full text and normalized mention-stripped body, including cross-form matches. Give natural videos precedence over diagnostic videos. Exclude empty normalized keys and keep an exclusion ledger. Historical disjointness is limited to available source identifiers.
diagnostic: From disjoint diagnostic videos, include all eligible initially blocked addressed comments in the frozen intent model's routing scope, irrespective of rule/model agreement. Never pool with natural estimates.
primary: Paired reduction in blocks per 1,000 human-style comments and change in AI-style recall vs the old guard. One-sided deployment criterion for a later confirmatory test: recall loss <= 0.02 absolute; this pilot estimates uncertainty, no threshold changes or model promotion.
uncertainty: Resample natural videos within each of the two topic pools, with replacement, 5000 repetitions, seed 20261122. Report undefined replicates. With few clusters or no discordant observations interpret percentile intervals descriptively.
review: Two independent humans, masked mentions, no video/author/predictions, separate permutations, three independent dimensions. Report pre-adjudication agreement, Cohen kappa, class totals and uncertain fraction. Human adjudication for each conflicting field. Uncertain consensus remains a separate reported class.
